title: Letwin smooth moment-map route: source targets and remaining gaps
scope: Letwin arXiv:2607.24164v1 Lemma 2.2 (smooth moment map) and the regularity it imports from Berman-Berndtsson arXiv:1207.6128v1 Theorem 2.24; state of the local library. Lemma A.1 (regular approximation) is formalized: ../../formalization/FunctionalInequalities/KLS/Letwin/Approximation.lean (exists_regular_approximation).

Letwin2026.lemma_2_2: Under the regularity assumptions of Lemma A.1 (dmu = e^{-V} 1_K dx, K bounded open convex, V smooth convex on an open neighbourhood of closure K, mu isotropic), the moment map phi of Lemma 2.1 is finite and smooth on R^n, Hess phi is positive definite at every point, grad phi: R^n -> K is a diffeomorphism, and rho(grad phi) det Hess phi = e^{-phi} pointwise, equivalently log det Hess phi = -phi + V(grad phi).

BermanBerndtsson2013.theorem_2_24: Omega bounded open convex, MA(phi) = f dx in Omega, phi = 0 on boundary, f > 0: (i) 1/C <= f <= C => strictly convex and C^{1,alpha}_loc some alpha > 0; (ii) f continuous => W^{2,p}_loc every p > 1; (iii) f smooth => smooth (Evans-Krylov + linear bootstrap).
caveats: Step 3 (p.21) writes C^{1,alpha}_loc for some alpha > 1; Theorem 2.24 (p.26) says alpha > 0. Use alpha > 0.
Step 3 applies Theorem 2.24 on sublevel sets {phi < R} after subtracting R (Dirichlet normalisation).
Point (iii) and Step 3 compress Evans-Krylov and Schauder bootstrapping into one sentence; smoothness is NOT a consequence of W^{2,p} or continuity of the right side alone.

route_scope.bridge: Lemma A.1 (exists_regular_approximation) yields every approximant in BOTH classes: open K = interior of a compact convex body, and V globally smooth and kappa-uniformly convex. stages.alternative_plan: PLAN ONLY, not proved; requires the actual C^2 upgrade of the witness (R9), unavailable at the current C^{1,1} witness. Once u is C^2, convexity gives Hess u positive semidefinite at every point. The a.e. data (Hess u PD, log det Hess u = g with g = -u + W(grad u)) give det Hess u = exp g a.e.; both sides are continuous and Lebesgue measure has full support, so the equality holds everywhere. A positive determinant upgrades PSD to PD, and then log det Hess u = g pointwise. This continuity/determinant bridge is an alternative to the viscosity route of the note above; it does not give smoothness, Harnack or the literal source class.
